_comment: MALICIOUS-CLASSIFICATION GATE for report figures (cti_refs.malicious_verdict / verdict_of; consumers: build_report_data.py `verdict`, cti_docx_postprocess heatmap gate, cti_report_figures registration-heatmap title). A figure may call a case's domains 'malicious' ONLY when the case's OWN recorded verdict supports it: scope.json `target_class` + assessment.json `premise_verdict` (harness/schemas.py vocabulary). Absent or unrecognised values are NOT malicious — a default never labels a domain malicious. Vocabulary only, never case data (RULE 1).

malicious_target_classes._comment: Intake classes (WebPivot/references/intake.json) whose premise, when the collection SUPPORTS it, is a malicious classification.

supporting_verdicts._comment: premise_verdict values that mean the collection supported the stated malicious premise. not_supported / inconclusive mean nothing was shown either way and never count.

benign_target_classes._comment: Intake classes whose premise is that the target is legitimate.

benign_refuting_verdicts._comment: premise_verdict values on a benign premise that amount to a malicious finding (the collection contradicted the legitimacy claim).

never_malicious_target_classes._comment: Classes whose hosts are victims, never the operator's malicious estate, whatever the verdict.
